title: BatchConfig
description: Configuration entity controlling parallel execution behavior for batch processing workflows

batch_size.description: Number of items to process in each batch. Balances throughput with failure blast radius.

max_concurrent.description: Maximum number of batches to execute simultaneously. Enforced via asyncio.Semaphore.

retry_strategy.description: Strategy for handling transient failures. Maps to RetryPolicy configuration.

request_timeout_seconds.description: Per-request timeout to prevent hung connections. 30s sufficient for 99% of requests.

retry_policy.description: Detailed retry configuration when retry_strategy is not 'none'

max_retries.description: Maximum retry attempts per request. 3 retries balances resilience with failure detection speed.

max_delay_seconds.description: Maximum delay cap for exponential backoff. Prevents unbounded wait times.

jitter_enabled.description: Add ±25% random variance to prevent thundering herd during synchronized retries

retryable_errors.description: Error types eligible for retry. Must not include permanent errors (HTTP_404, HTTP_401, HTTP_403).
